novel_features.name: Spend report
novel_features.description: See cumulative API spend across every Exa call, broken down by day and resource.
novel_features.rationale: Every Exa response carries costDollars.total but no endpoint aggregates spend; only the local store can join cost across calls.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents should reach for this when they need to know how much Exa usage costs before running another batch.

novel_features.name: Monitor run diff
novel_features.description: Compare two synced monitor runs and see exactly which URLs are new, gone, or unchanged.
novel_features.rationale: Joining two monitor-run result sets is a local-SQLite operation the Exa API cannot express.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to see what a scheduled search found since the last run instead of re-reading entire run outputs.

novel_features.name: Entity report
novel_features.description: Build a first-seen / last-seen / mention-count timeline for any company or person across your synced searches and webset items.
novel_features.rationale: Requires an FTS5 join across webset entity items and search/monitor results that only exists together in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to track when an entity first appeared and how often it shows up across all your research surfaces.

novel_features.name: Webset new
novel_features.description: List items added to a live webset since your last sync, so you only see what changed.
novel_features.rationale: Diffing current synced item state against the previous snapshot is a local join; the API exposes items but not deltas.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for the weekly what's-new sweep over a curated set instead of re-listing every item.

narrative.headline: Every Exa search API feature, plus local history, spend tracking, and diffing no other Exa tool has.
narrative.value_prop: exa-pp-cli wraps the full Exa API — search, contents, answer, find-similar, monitors, agent runs, websets, webhooks, imports — and adds a local SQLite store so every result, run, and cost lands on disk. Re-run past queries, diff monitor runs, track entity first-seens, and watch spend in real time.

quickstart.comment: Verify the install and API key wiring without spending credits.
Run a semantic web search with key excerpts for agent context.
Extract clean markdown text from a known URL.

quickstart.command: exa-pp-cli answer --query "What is the capital of France?"
quickstart.comment: Get a grounded LLM answer with citations.
Persist monitor run history locally, then query it offline.
See per-day, per-resource API spend from stored cost data.

troubleshoots.fix: Set EXA_API_KEY to a key from https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys; pass it via Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key.
Top up credits at dashboard.exa.ai or raise the API key spending budget.
Search is limited to 10 QPS and contents to 100 QPS; the CLI retries with backoff, slow down parallel loops.

troubleshoots.symptom: contents returns 200 but some URLs failed
troubleshoots.fix: Check the statuses[] array in the response for per-URL error tags like CRAWL_NOT_FOUND.
Rephrase the query or adjust parameters; the model could not answer from available information.

narrative.when_to_use: Use exa-pp-cli whenever an agent needs live web research with grounded citations, clean page content, scheduled monitoring, or entity tracking — and wants every search persisted locally for later querying.
anti_triggers: Do not use exa-pp-cli for general web crawling at scale; use a dedicated crawler.
Do not use exa-pp-cli to bypass paywalls or scrape restricted content.
Do not use exa-pp-cli for real-time monitoring dashboards at sub-second cadence; use the API directly.

recipes.title: Deep research with structured output
recipes.command: exa-pp-cli websearch --query "compare the latest frontier AI model releases" --type deep --output-schema '{"type":"object","required":["models"],"properties":{"models":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object"}}}}'
recipes.explanation: Run deep search and get a synthesized, schema-shaped answer with grounding.

recipes.title: Monitor a competitor's news
recipes.command: exa-pp-cli monitors create --name "competitor-news" --search-query "new product launches" --search-contents-highlights true
recipes.explanation: Schedule a recurring search, then run `sync` to persist runs locally.

recipes.title: What changed since last monitor run
recipes.explanation: Schedule a recurring search, then run `sync` to persist runs locally.

recipes.title: Track an entity over time
recipes.explanation: Get an agent-shaped first-seen/last-seen timeline for a company across all synced research.

recipes.title: Narrow a search response with --select
recipes.command: exa-pp-cli websearch --query "AI regulation policy updates" --category news --num-results 5 --select results.title,results.url
recipes.explanation: Request only the high-gravity fields so agent context is not flooded with full result payloads.
